headline: New contract with Portland Administrators Association approved unanimously
summary: Negotiations with the Portland Administrators Association were discussed in executive session. Back in public session, the vote to adopt a new collective bargaining agreement with the association passed unanimously.
decisions: Approved the collective bargaining agreement with the Portland Administrators Association, passed unanimously.
discussion: Contract readings: A question was raised whether the contract needed a first and second read. The chair said labor contracts do not need two readings and are voted on the same night.
Association thanks: The association's president thanked the board for the vote and said administrators anchor schools and families.

decision_evidence.quote: Um roll-call vote, please indicate whether you are in favor for the adoption and collective bargaining agreement with the Portland uh Administrators Association, the PAA. ... So that motion passes unanimously

decision_titles: Adoption of collective bargaining agreement with Portland Administrators Association
